text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Mejiro Palmer laughing it up with
some
friends in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Can you, like, believe Helios said that?!
I was
legit crying with laughter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ohoho! I say, what a simply
riveting story!

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Friend
text_block_list.text: Um, girl? What was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
N-nothing, nothing! I'm just a bit tired,
so my
brain's all fried!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Just pretend you didn't hear me,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like all her back-to-back races
are
getting to her. I need to adjust her
schedule, and
the sooner the better.
